note: Link-only external packs: the owner's exception of 2026-10-30 ('keep the ultraHD links for now and other similar'). HD graphics packs ship client patch files, so they are never index entries; each is a link to its authors' own page (repo, official page or announcement thread), with our own words. Never mirrored, never installable. url must be a page, never a file or a file host; repo (optional) is its GitHub repo, the only place a preview image may come from. hub_index.py build writes them to the index's top-level "external" list.

packs.name: UltraHD Graphics Modpack
packs.summary: A high-resolution texture and model pack announced for the Conquest community client. Downloaded from its authors' own page.
